en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a broad cobblestone market square with several historic buildings. Dominating the right side is an ornate Gothic-revival style town hall with stepped gables, arched entrance, and the word "Rathskeller" on its facade. On the left are simpler townhouses, one bearing the sign "Thüringer Hof". A lone figure stands in the open square. The bottom margin contains printed caption text identifying the scene as the market and town hall of Mügeln, and the publisher information.
